sloka: एष धर्मः पुरा द्Rष्टः लोके वेदे श्रुतः स्म्Rतः ।अग्निकार्येषु च सदा सुमनोभिश्च देवताः ॥२-२४-२७॥
transliteration: eṣa dharmaḥ purā dRṣṭaḥ loke vede śrutaḥ smRtaḥ ।agnikāryeṣu ca sadā sumanobhiśca devatāḥ ॥2-24-27॥

translations.english: A wife who serves her husband and who is engaged in doing good to him is righteous. This dharma exists in this world since ancient times, declared in the Vedas and the smritis.
